chapter: Post office, day job and quitting
title: Heart attack and his daughter's lessons
summary: His heart attack and inability to play a project, and teaching his small daughter piano.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: But, uh, I was unfortunate, I had a heart attack in July of last year. So, they called me while I was recuperating, around the end of the siege, asking me to go play a project at the very, uh, Dajon's going this evening, up at the Trader Hospital on the third floor. Man, I was anxious to go. I wanted to get out there again. But the boss said no. No, well.
But I did like to play the piano, and, uh, before I got older I used to like to sing, and play. You don't look old, you're not old yet.
No, I know, but I mean, uh. Fif hundred to fifty-two, about? Fifty-two, yeah. But I mean, uh, the reflexes are gone, you know. Oh yeah, in some respects you're losing.
